subject: tr-info
title: (R)TR.INFO. -----ACC.DY.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-14 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — France/Italy/Northern Europe/Japan) accompanying Braxton's pivot from French infrastructure to French historical contribution: 'France has long been involved in creative music throughout its history. It was in France that the activity of Django Reinhardt was to solidify.' (R)TR-INFO (the reality of transfer information) is crossed with ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics): the question is what transfer-information produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with accelerated-dynamics — the (R) prefix marking that real transfer (Reinhardt's actual musical lineage from gypsy tradition into modern jazz) is what produces accelerated-dynamics in the French scene. ACC-DY itself sits at the upper-center. IST-PT (interior-source point) feeds in from the upper-right. LK-IMP (linkage implication) anchors the right output. RT-INT-TR (reality-interior traits) hangs on the upper-right margin. PART (participation) sits between subject and partner. CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics) form the right output cluster. INFO-AF-B (information-affinity basis) anchors the lower-right. EXP-DYM (extended-dynamics) feeds in from below-left. Structural argument: transfer-information-as-real crossed with accelerated-dynamics is mediated by participation as central hub, with interior-source-point as upper upstream and extended-dynamics as lower upstream. The diagram exposes Braxton's structural commitment about why France produces durable creative musicians (Reinhardt, Grappelli): real transfer-information (the actual lineage of musical material from one tradition to another) crossing with accelerated-dynamics requires participation as the live hub — and France's culture, despite its institutional gaps for native musicians, does sustain that participation hub. The productive outputs (linkage-implication, reality-interior-traits, culture-solidification, affinity-dynamics, information-affinity-basis) all register the deep musical accomplishment that France enables.
